dct_description_sm: This shapefile provides information about the extent and availability of aerial photograph coverage across Ethiopia. This dataset is valuable for professionals and researchers involved in cartography, land use planning, environmental monitoring, and infrastructure development, as it helps identify areas with existing aerial imagery and potential gaps where additional coverage may be needed.​ For more detailed information: [Ethiopia Arial Photo Coverage ](https://data.moa.gov.et/dataset/ethiopia-arial-photo-coverage1)
